headline: Rhine falls to record low as drought strains Europe's rivers
summary: Record-low water levels in the Rhine, Danube and Po are curtailing shipping, cutting power output and squeezing industry.
script: Europe's rivers are at record lows. The Rhine, Danube and Po have fallen to levels not seen in decades, forcing ships to carry less cargo and cutting electricity output across the continent.
imageAlt: A view of the Rhine showing exposed riverbanks at record-low water levels.
imageAltTwo: Cargo barges navigating a shallow stretch of the Rhine.
